ImageDescription.value: Aerial shot of the area around the Binnenrotte with the railway viaduct, in the foreground on the left the Blaak and at the very front the Wijnhaven with houses, with the Noordzee office building on the corner of the Korte Wijnbrugstraat. In the middle the Westnieuwland, the Kolk, and the Oudehaven, with the post office and the Beurs, the Beurs station and behind it the Plan C collective building. In the background on the left is the Grote or Sint-Laurenskerk. Year: 1921.
